summary: Iteration 9 - Progres Barang stage-entry model overhaul fully verified. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests PASS (test_iter9.py) covering (a) POST /api/progres per-stage entry creation with sisa_setelah_input + upstream_label, (b) pipeline validation grinda<=BM sisa returns 400 'melebihi sisa dari Barang Masuk', servis<=grinda_sum-servis_sum -> 'melebihi sisa dari Grinda', finishing -> 'dari Servis', packing -> 'dari Finishing', (c) multiple entries same barang aggregate correctly in /progres/by-po, /progres/entries returns rows sorted tanggal desc, (d) sisa_grinda/sisa_servis/sisa_finishing/sisa_packing fields all >=0, (e) new barang_masuk increments qty_masuk and updates sisa_grinda, (f) packing entries flow to PO.qty_ready, (g) DELETE /api/progres/{id} admin-only (staff=403), (h) legacy migration verified - GET /api/progres shows only stage entries (no legacy cumulative docs), (i) SPKItem model validation returns 422 for qty<1 and missing nama_barang, (j) update_bm validate-first regression preserved. Frontend: Progres dialog opens with Stage select, Tanggal (default today = 2026-07-25), Qty input, PO+barang cascade shows context info box 'Barang Masuk: 400 • Sudah di grinda: 10 • Sisa yang bisa diinput: 390' with progres-context-info and progres-sisa-hint testids. 24 progres-sisa-<stage>-<po>-<item> tiles + 6 toggle-history-<po>-<item> buttons on list. History panel opens successfully. DialogDescription warnings count = 0 (all 7 pages fixed).

issues: Still uses browser-native <input type='date'> (per iter7/8 finding). Not blocking; consider shadcn Calendar+Popover for consistency.

action_items: (OPTIONAL/NAMING) Test spec used 'progres-select-stage' but code uses 'progres-stage-select' - minor inconsistency vs review_request; both work fine, just document consistent naming.
(OPTIONAL/DESIGN) Consider replacing browser-native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar+Popover across Progres/BM/Staffing/PO/SPK for consistent date UX (repeat finding from iter7/8).
(OPTIONAL/CODE) server.py is now 1956 lines - splitting into routes/ + models/ modules deferred per iter9 spec, still recommended for maintainability.
(OPTIONAL/CLEANUP) The pytest class-scoped fixture 'defined as instance method' PytestRemovedIn10Warning still emitted (cosmetic, will error in pytest v10).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_progres_entry (line ~866-881): sisa validation and 400 error message look good. Manual mode (po_id='') bypasses BM validation for grinda (upstream=inf) but still enforces internal servis->finishing->packing pipeline via _get_stage_sums('', item_id) - correct.
server.py get_progres_by_po (line ~934-1022): still O(POs * items) build loop, but stage aggregation now uses $group pipeline. Acceptable for current data volume.
server.py migration block (line ~284-311): idempotent - only runs when docs without 'stage' field exist. Meta fields (nama_barang, nama_pengrajin, spesifikasi, gambar_path) preserved. Good.
server.py PREV_STAGE constant makes pipeline explicit and easy to reason about. Nice.
ProgresBarang.jsx (364 lines): well structured with STAGES constant, getStageContext helper, and separate history panel. Zero console errors.
The qty_ready sync happens because /api/po getters recompute packing_sum via _get_packing_map $group aggregation - no denormalization drift.
SPKItem model with qty: int = Field(ge=1) properly rejects qty<1 with 422.
update_bm at line 1457-1491 correctly validates ALL items before mutating PO qty_diterima (own_old subtraction pattern) - regression fix from iter6 intact.
